Run these commands on the computer runni: Run these commands on the computer running OpenClaw or Hermes, with Node.js and npm installed. Pair uses Relay; pair local uses your local network.
Clawket does not use browser origin auth: Clawket does not use browser origin authentication, but some OpenClaw versions require allowedOrigins to start a non-loopback Gateway with Control UI enabled. Keep the exact browser origins in the examples.
Relay needs internet access on both the: Relay needs internet access on both the phone and the host. Keep the host awake and the Clawket Bridge running.
For LAN, put the phone and host on the s: For LAN, put the phone and host on the same network. For Tailscale, connect both devices to the same tailnet.
Direct OpenClaw uses port 18789 by defau: Direct OpenClaw uses port 18789 by default; Hermes local pairing uses 4319. Use the port printed by the CLI. Relay does not require opening these ports to the internet.
For OpenClaw, credentials may come from: For OpenClaw, credentials may come from openclaw.json, environment variables or SecretRef. Do not copy a SecretRef as a token. After credentials change, run pairing again and use the new code or QR in Add connection. Hermes does not use openclaw.json.
After a network change, the app reconnec: After a network change, the app reconnects automatically. In Account settings, open Connections, select the connection and tap Reconnect or Resume connection. If it still fails, check the host and Bridge; restart a managed Bridge with the command below.
If a pairing code has expired or was alr: If a pairing code has expired or was already used, run pairing again on the host. Select the matching backend in the app and use the new code or QR. Official Preview codes only work with Preview enabled.
For OpenClaw only: run the update comman: For OpenClaw only: run the update command on the host and follow its instructions. Then check Gateway status. If you changed its configuration, restart the installed Gateway service.
In Add connection, choose the backend an: In Add connection, choose the backend and enter its pairing code, or scan or import its QR. Local pairing uses QR. If both backends are installed, the CLI prints a result for each. Keep the host running.
OpenClaw only: merge these fields into t: OpenClaw only: merge these fields into the existing gateway configuration; do not replace the whole file. Replace address placeholders and use a strong private token instead of replace-me. Restart Gateway, then run the URL pairing command and scan its QR.
For OpenClaw and Hermes, run these check: For OpenClaw and Hermes, run these checks on the host. Status and doctor inspect Clawket services; logs follows their output until Ctrl+C. If a paired Bridge is stopped, use start. For local OpenClaw, also check Gateway below.
